resources.string: Page Brawl: brawl on this page

Turns your screen into a ring: icons, text, buttons and notifications become the ground the fighters fight on, lock screen included. Page Brawl reads where things are on screen only while the ring is on, checks whether they have text only to treat them as solid, and stores or sends nothing. It never acts inside your apps. Page Brawl is a game, not an accessibility tool.
